recentItems.title: Preparing For Rotterdam 2026 With Team USA 🇺🇸🤸‍♀️
recentItems.description:
Four-time World team member and two-time champion Skye Blakely is the only athlete on the women’s team with World Championships experience, but she’s far from the only one to watch. Joining her are 2024 Olympic gold medalist and two-time U.S. all-around champion Hezly Rivera, 2026 U.S. all-around silver and bronze medalists Claire Pease and Charleigh Bullock, and 2026 U.S. floor champion and U.S. Classic all-around champion Reese Esponda. With plenty of talent across the roster, the team offers a glimpse of the future of U.S. women’s gymnastics in Rotterdam.

recentItems.title: Team Brazil 🇧🇷 women - from gymnastics to life preferences, a good laugh is guaranteed #RoadToLA28
Jade Carey Vaulting to Bronze 🥉| Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Despite winning floor gold at Tokyo 2020, a trip on the runway during the vault final motivated Jade Carey for a Paris 2024 run. She got redemption there, earning vault bronze in addition to the team triumph. Following her second trip to the Games, Carey wrapped her record-setting collegiate career at Oregon State University, and took a break from the sport before feeling like she had more to give; and one more Olympic run in her, sights set firmly on LA28
